mechanics.title: Formatting
mechanics.description: Choose 12 or 24 hour time, seconds, milliseconds, and date parts (year, month, day, weekday, time zone). Timezone is detected automatically.

mechanics.title: Style
mechanics.description: Color, bold, italic, underline; option to show the timestamp only on hover instead of as a prefix.

qol: See when chat messages were sent
editor_notes: In-game settings need Mod Menu and Cloth Config.
name: Plague's Chat Timestamps
summary: Adds a customizable timestamp to every chat message so you can see when messages were sent, for example after being AFK.
